snippet.title: Imagine Sisyphus Happy - Exclusive Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Sisyphus is Streaming! A weird mixture of Streamer Simulator, Typing and Minigames about life, spectacle, and making the grind worth living. Push the boulder. Do tricks. Unlock new struggles. Choose your boulder, and try to Imagine Sisyphus Happy!
